LUMINOS CITY GUIDE
==================

ATTRACTIONS:
------------

1. The Prism Palace
   - Opening hours: 9:30 AM - 7:00 PM
   - Admission: $35 per person
   - Description: Ancient palace with walls that refract sunlight into rainbow displays

2. Neon District Walking Tour
   - Opening hours: Tours at 11:00 AM, 2:00 PM, 5:00 PM, 8:00 PM
   - Admission: $20 per person (guided tour)
   - Description: Historic district known for holographic street art and light installations

3. Mirror Lake Observatory
   - Opening hours: 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM
   - Admission: $22 per person
   - Description: Lake with perfectly reflective surface, observatory for astronomy

4. Lightwave Science Center
   - Opening hours: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
   - Admission: $28 per person
   - Description: Interactive museum exploring physics of light and color

5. Golden Hour Plaza
   - Open 24/7
   - Admission: Free
   - Description: Central plaza designed to maximize sunset viewing, surrounded by cafes


SUGGESTED ITINERARY:
--------------------

DAY 1: Festival of Lights Tour

9:30 AM - 12:00 PM: The Prism Palace
- Travel time from city center: 18 minutes by express metro
- Express metro fare: $5.00
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $35

12:30 PM - 2:00 PM: Lunch at Golden Hour Plaza
- Travel time from Prism Palace: 12 minutes by metro
- Metro fare: $3.50
- Average meal cost: $18-28
- Duration: 1.5 hours
- Admission: Free

2:00 PM - 4:30 PM: Lightwave Science Center
- Travel time from Plaza: 8 minutes walking
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $28

5:00 PM - 7:00 PM: Neon District Walking Tour (5:00 PM departure)
- Travel time from Science Center: 25 minutes by monorail
- Monorail fare: $4.50
- Duration of tour: 2 hours
- Cost: $20

7:30 PM - 10:00 PM: Mirror Lake Observatory
- Travel time from Neon District: 30 minutes by river ferry
- Ferry fare: $7.00
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $22
- Light dinner available at observatory cafe ($15-25)

10:30 PM: Return to city center
- Travel time: 20 minutes by night bus
- Night bus fare: $3.00

TOTAL ESTIMATED COSTS:
- Admissions: $105

LUMINOS CITY GUIDE
==================

ATTRACTIONS:
------------

1. The Prism Palace
   - Opening hours: 9:30 AM - 7:00 PM
   - Admission: $35 per person
   - Description: Ancient palace with walls that refract sunlight into rainbow displays

2. Neon District Walking Tour
   - Opening hours: Tours at 11:00 AM, 2:00 PM, 5:00 PM, 8:00 PM
   - Admission: $20 per person (guided tour)
   - Description: Historic district known for holographic street art and light installations

3. Mirror Lake Observatory
   - Opening hours: 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM
   - Admission: $22 per person
   - Description: Lake with perfectly reflective surface, observatory for astronomy

4. Lightwave Science Center
   - Opening hours: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
   - Admission: $28 per person
   - Description: Interactive museum exploring physics of light and color

5. Golden Hour Plaza
   - Open 24/7
   - Admission: Free
   - Description: Central plaza designed to maximize sunset viewing, surrounded by cafes


SUGGESTED ITINERARY:
--------------------

DAY 1: Festival of Lights Tour

9:30 AM - 12:00 PM: The Prism Palace
- Travel time from city center: 18 minutes by express metro
- Express metro fare: $5.00
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $35

12:30 PM - 2:00 PM: Lunch at Golden Hour Plaza
- Travel time from Prism Palace: 12 minutes by metro
- Metro fare: $3.50
- Average meal cost: $18-28
- Duration: 1.5 hours
- Admission: Free

2:00 PM - 4:30 PM: Lightwave Science Center
- Travel time from Plaza: 8 minutes walking
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $28

5:00 PM - 7:00 PM: Neon District Walking Tour (5:00 PM departure)
- Travel time from Science Center: 25 minutes by monorail
- Monorail fare: $4.50
- Duration of tour: 2 hours
- Cost: $20

7:30 PM - 10:00 PM: Mirror Lake Observatory
- Travel time from Neon District: 30 minutes by river ferry
- Ferry fare: $7.00
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $22
- Light dinner available at observatory cafe ($15-25)

10:30 PM: Return to city center
- Travel time: 20 minutes by night bus
- Night bus fare: $3.00

TOTAL ESTIMATED COSTS:
- Admissions: $105
- Transportation: $23
- Meals: $33-53
- Grand Total: $161-181 per person

SPECIAL NOTE: Visit during the annual Luminos Light Festival (held in October) for extended hours and special illuminations at all attractions!

LUMINOS CITY GUIDE
==================

ATTRACTIONS:
------------

1. The Prism Palace
   - Opening hours: 9:30 AM - 7:00 PM
   - Admission: $35 per person
   - Description: Ancient palace with walls that refract sunlight into rainbow displays

2. Neon District Walking Tour
   - Opening hours: Tours at 11:00 AM, 2:00 PM, 5:00 PM, 8:00 PM
   - Admission: $20 per person (guided tour)
   - Description: Historic district known for holographic street art and light installations

3. Mirror Lake Observatory
   - Opening hours: 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM
   - Admission: $22 per person
   - Description: Lake with perfectly reflective surface, observatory for astronomy

4. Lightwave Science Center
   - Opening hours: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
   - Admission: $28 per person
   - Description: Interactive museum exploring physics of light and color

5. Golden Hour Plaza
   - Open 24/7
   - Admission: Free
   - Description: Central plaza designed to maximize sunset viewing, surrounded by cafes


SUGGESTED ITINERARY:
--------------------

DAY 1: Festival of Lights Tour

9:30 AM - 12:00 PM: The Prism Palace
- Travel time from city center: 18 minutes by express metro
- Express metro fare: $5.00
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $35

12:30 PM - 2:00 PM: Lunch at Golden Hour Plaza
- Travel time from Prism Palace: 12 minutes by metro
- Metro fare: $3.50
- Average meal cost: $18-28
- Duration: 1.5 hours
- Admission: Free

2:00 PM - 4:30 PM: Lightwave Science Center
- Travel time from Plaza: 8 minutes walking
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $28

5:00 PM - 7:00 PM: Neon District Walking Tour (5:00 PM departure)
- Travel time from Science Center: 25 minutes by monorail
- Monorail fare: $4.50
- Duration of tour: 2 hours
- Cost: $20

7:30 PM - 10:00 PM: Mirror Lake Observatory
- Travel time from Neon District: 30 minutes by river ferry
- Ferry fare: $7.00
- Duration of visit: 2.5 hours
- Cost: $22
- Light dinner available at observatory cafe ($15-25)

10:30 PM: Return to city center
- Travel time: 20 minutes by night bus
- Night bus fare: $3.00

TOTAL ESTIMATED COSTS:
- Admissions: $105
- Transportation: $23
- Meals: $33-53
- Grand Total: $161-181 per person

SPECIAL NOTE: Visit during the annual Luminos Light Festival (held in October) for extended hours and special illuminations at all attractions!
